title: Open where the reader left off

do.text: Open a chat at its newest message (or the last question), where people expect to continue.

dont.text: Don't open a long chat at its first message: people scroll through everything to reply.

do.text: Follow new messages only while the reader is at the end; offer a jump back otherwise.

dont.text: Don't snap to new messages while someone reads history: they lose their place.
